name: engram
description: Engram 仿人脑分层长期记忆的 Kimi Code 适配器：首条 prompt 注入记忆热索引、会话结束自动复盘巩固，并提供 engram skill 让 agent 在该检索时主动回溯记忆。单 Rust 二进制、零外部依赖。

interface.shortDescription: Human-like layered long-term memory for Kimi Code
interface.longDescription: Engram injects a memory hot-index on the first prompt of each session and runs an independent headless reviewer at session end to consolidate what mattered (promote/demote, supersede, merge). An engram skill teaches the agent recall-first: when asked what a project is, what's left to do, or whether something was handled before, it recalls from memory before scanning code. Portable Rust engine + redb store, no external services. Shares the same memory stores with the Claude Code / Codex / opencode adapters.
